snippet.title: Champion of Lore First Teaser
snippet.description:
🕹️ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4046650/Champion_of_Lore/
💬 Shape the myths with us: https://discord.gg/nVE8bMkcdG

When Guardians are not enough… a Champion must rise.

Champion of Lore is a turn-based, deck-building strategy game.

Command heroes born from world mythologies, forge powerful decks, and face the corruption threatening the world.

🛡️ From the creators of Guardian of Lore,
Round 2 Games is an independent studio devoted to crafting worlds that inspire, challenge, and leave a lasting mark through meaningful stories and innovative mechanics.

🌐 Learn more at https://round2-games.com/
